verdict.rationale: Mollie documents several low-effort routes to taking card payments: plug-in modules where installing is "enough to start receiving payments", hosted checkout pages, embeddable PCI-compliant card fields, and no-code payment links. Test mode lets a founder rehearse the flow before going live. However, nothing in the pack covers how long signup, verification and live card activation take, so the "within a day" timing is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented onboarding/KYC timeline from signup to live card acceptance, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.
